content.value: Explain the working of the Selective Repeat (SR) protocol. Given a sequence number (13) [CO3] space of 4 and a sender window size of 3, determine whether the window size is appropriate for SR protocol. Discuss the problems that can occur if the window size 3 exceeds the allowed limit with a timeline diagram.
